description: This file defines the MatchDifference class used for tracking differences in request matching, including detailed failure logging and comparison of request fields.

classes.name: MatchDifference
classes.description: Class for representing differences between expected and actual request matchings, with detailed logging capabilities.

classes.name: MatchDifference.Field
classes.description: Enumeration of request fields that can be compared for differences.

methods.name: addDifference
methods.description: Adds a difference message, optionally logging it with context.

methods.name: getHttpRequest
methods.description: Returns the associated HTTP request definition.

methods.name: getLogCorrelationId
methods.description: Retrieves the log correlation ID from the request.

methods.name: currentField
methods.description: Sets the current field being compared.

methods.name: getDifferences
methods.description: Retrieves differences for a specific field.

methods.name: addDifferences
methods.description: Adds multiple differences from a map.
